title: Checklist reveal
description: A title, then items that slide in one by one and get a drawn check mark; times can follow the voiceover.

title.description: Heading above the main element. Trusted HTML: use word for the accent word.

items.description: Item labels (3-6 fit; keep each under ~32 characters).

times.description: Optional scene-local seconds for each item (e.g. when the voice names it). Empty = start + i * gap.

start.description: First item time when times is empty.

gap.description: Seconds between items when times is empty.

checkDelay.description: Seconds between an item appearing and its check.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: textcheck: long labels wrap inside the card
